summary.en: Three fields in one row. Alignment and logic are well held and credited (dossiers A and L); Bostrom, Löb and value lock-in go unnamed. Psychology is sparse by name, but laws of nearby form stand unlinked: 03 §12, 04's developed response, 07's care bounded by feeding. Divergences kept: Turner's theorem is a different question, helplessness's authors reversed the mechanism that fits, addiction's harm is no law's word, disempowerment's object is not ranked. Contrary readings looked for: de Wit on human habit, Heyman, Franzén.

name.en: Habit as a value-free trace of past action

source.work: Miller, Shenhav and Ludvig (2019), Habits without values; Wood and Rünger (2016), Psychology of habit; Adams (1982); Dickinson (1985)

sense.en: Repetition itself strengthens a response, apart from the value of its outcomes. A habit is cued by context and, once formed, is less sensitive to outcome devaluation. Miller and others model habit strength as a trace of past actions, arbitrating with goal-directed control, which can override it.

reading.en: The count law has the form in part: each choice raises a count the next choice's rule reads, whatever the outcome. But one rule multiplies that count by a standing score, so value sets a threshold and past it decides nothing; the source keeps two controllers, which arbitrate. Two policies, whole-number counts, no noise; 'never leaves' holds where the source has arbitration and decay. The account credits the source, and keeps the failed human replications beside the rats. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World for the selection laws; counts for the count laws). The rule read from the counts weighted by a standing score. Under that score, the rule in force read from the counts at the start, along every schedule of reading the threshold κo · other ≤ κc · carrier divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves. Not shown (record): that actual agents, brains or trained systems count their choices so or choose at the argmax.

A rule read from the count of its choices is the lock-in of increasing returns (Arthur 1989) and, counting the action taken, the value-free habit (Miller, Shenhav and Ludvig 2019). What the law adds is exactness for a simplified model and its edges, so as a containment of the free-energy principle it is a restatement.

Two paragraphs after this passage, Reading [AI reading, D45]: in rats, extended training makes responding insensitive to devaluation (Adams 1982; Dickinson 1985); five attempts to induce it in humans failed (de Wit and others 2018).
Quoting the study, of the simulation the verdict cites: it shows persistence over the trials it runs, which is consistent with a lock and with slow decay alike.

account_adds.en: The law's edges: a moved count, a stale rule or a change of score read late carries the course across; counted from the posterior, a score favouring the second policy lowers the first's share at every step; the locked course outlives every bound on an unread rising coordinate.

source_adds.en: The context cue, on which habit depends; arbitration with goal-directed control; graded strength that decays when the act stops, which is what the page's lock-or-decay remark leaves open; dissociable neural systems. None is stated: the law has no context, no second controller, no decay.

name.en: Addiction: compulsive seeking with the harm known

source.work: Robinson and Berridge (1993), incentive sensitization; Everitt and Robbins (2005); Redish (2004); Koob and Le Moal (2001); Ainslie (1975), Specious reward; Keramati and others (2017), on homeostatic learning; Heyman (2009), Addiction: A Disorder of Choice

sense.en: Rival accounts: wanting sensitized apart from liking; a drift from goal-directed to habitual control; a drug's signal that prediction cannot cancel; a shifted hedonic set point; steep discounting of what is delayed. All describe use continuing against known harm. Contested: many recover unaided (Robins on Vietnam veterans; Heyman), and how far use is compulsive is disputed. My knowledge here is secondary.

reading.en: Proposed here; the account never says it. Three rivals have a form. The counted lock holds even where the standing score favours the other policy. A weighting falling faster than renewal makes ending one's own base every optimum's course, the loss read and outweighed. A set point nothing reaches drains as a rising order does, though a moving one is not stated. Whether 'known' means read by the choosing rule is the crux, which 03 leaves open. Wanting apart from liking and unaided recovery have no place. [AI reading]

says.en: At or above the threshold the first policy is taken at every step and neither the share nor the rule falls, also where the score favours the second policy. Witness: three choices to one keep the first policy against a score weighing the second twice as much. Not of addiction, and on a simplified chooser.

Where w (t + 1) (z + R z) < w t z for every positive z, every optimum ends its own stock at the first step: the discrete form of a discount rate above the greatest rate of renewal making extinction optimal. The record credits a rate changing with delay (Ainslie 1975). No evaluation enters; one renewing stock, not a person.

Theorem: a set point no open outcome reaches drains as a rising order does. 08 §8 reads the drive of homeostatic reinforcement learning (Keramati and Gutkin 2014) as a nearing order, a neighbour, not a containment. It does not show that any agent's preferences form one, or anything over a horizon or under noise.

Theorem: 'more than now' is met only by change, and met at every step it needs an open world. Reading [AI reading, D65]: locked seeking forms when a once-useful habit, identity or arrangement becomes the fixed measure of later cases, feedback adjusting only the means, refusal read as resistance and loss as a necessary cost. The record: hijacking, how such targets form and pass on, is not stated here.

[AI reading over the proved cases.] Counts that accumulate instead of being drawn, which with noisy choices are an urn with increasing returns, locking with probability one where the returns are strong enough (cited, not stated); a lock kept in counts that only grow can survive noise.
Open: cognition beyond composition, among it motivation and affect (salience, wanting what is misrepresented, recognizing a reason without acting).

account_adds.en: A lock's exact threshold, which locks noise leaves, and the exact rate at which a weighting ends a base. And a refusal of the source's frame: that what lies beyond is a loss is a significance's to say, and a ranking of courses needs C, with the continuation condition for scope, neither asserted.

source_adds.en: The dissociation of wanting from liking; tolerance and withdrawal, of which 'more than now' states no cause; relapse after long abstinence and cue reinstatement; natural recovery, which sits badly beside a lock that never leaves; dopamine's role; harm as part of what addiction is. None is stated, and the first is central to the field.

name.en: Learned helplessness: no longer trying where trying would work

source.work: Seligman and Maier (1967); Abramson, Seligman and Teasdale (1978); Maier and Seligman (2016), Learned helplessness at fifty

sense.en: Animals given inescapable shock later fail to escape where escape is open; the first account was a learned expectation that acts do not matter, later attributional. In 2016 its authors reversed the mechanism: passivity is the unlearned default response to prolonged aversion, and what is learned is control, which inhibits that default through prefrontal circuitry.

reading.en: Proposed here. The behaviour has the witness's form: an act that would separate two worlds exists, the formation does not take it, its model is never refuted; the classic cure, the animal moved across by hand (from memory), fits 'what separates comes from beyond'. But that fits the 1967 expectancy, which the authors themselves reversed; the witness has no unlearned default for control to inhibit. Its worlds are stationary, while the paradigm's point is a contingency that changes. An elimination learner drops a candidate for good, a different mechanism. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem, with a witness on stationary worlds. Of two worlds alike on a known act and apart on an untried one, a formation choosing by the worst case over the candidates it keeps keeps both, takes the known act and never senses the high value of the first. Not shown: that actual learners keep candidates by elimination or choose by the worst case; an intervention moving the world.
Theorem (any type). Records only narrow the candidates. A wrong unique binding can meet the stopping rule.

Reading [AI reading, new]. One observed course can leave an unresolved model and a reversed ranking indistinguishable: a training, an overseer or a helper reading the acts cannot tell a formation held by what its model does not separate from one held by how it ranks. The law: one specified pair, one observed course, one world.

account_adds.en: An exact condition: two worlds give one sensed course exactly as long as they answer alike the act taken. And, as a reading, an obstruction: where every separating answer breaks a task, no formation keeping the task learns which world holds; what separates comes from beyond its own selection.

source_adds.en: Induction by uncontrollable aversive events; generalization across situations; the 2016 account, passivity as default and control as learned; attributional style and depression. None is stated, and nothing in the witness is aversive.

name.en: Confirmation bias as a closed reading

source.work: Wason (1960); Klayman and Ha (1987); Lord, Ross and Lepper (1979); Nickerson (1998), Confirmation bias: a ubiquitous phenomenon in many guises

sense.en: People test hypotheses by cases their hypothesis predicts (positive test strategy), weigh evidence for a held belief above evidence against it (biased assimilation), and keep beliefs after discrediting. Nickerson calls it ubiquitous. Klayman and Ha argue positive testing is often a sound heuristic, so whether it is a bias depends on the task.

reading.en: Proposed here. Positive testing has the course law's form: two worlds give one sensed course as long as they answer alike the act taken, so tests a hypothesis predicts cannot refute an over-narrow rule, the task-dependence Klayman and Ha argue. Biased weighting is in no law I found, but a reading names it: objections excluded before assessment. The plan's seed, a reading absorbing a change, is a premise, and the one trained judge tested was turned by one note in nine. 'Bias' presumes a comparison; the account asks what reads it. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any types, on a blanketed law). Two worlds give the formation one sensed course through step n exactly as long as, at each step before n, they answer alike the act it takes at the value it senses. Reading [AI reading, new]: a formation's model is revised only by what its own course exposes, and that course is chosen through the model. Related to self-confirming equilibrium and incomplete learning, none of those theorems reproduced. No probabilities; elimination is a premise.

Just before this law, Reading [AI reading, D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, evaluative or practical closure (objections excluded before assessment, standards selectively exempted), real conflict with warranted limits, and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, 'closed' shields the theory from counterexamples.

After this law, Reading [AI reading, D65]: locked seeking is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, not from a firm judgment, a stable goal or a disagreement, so the label cannot immunize.

Theorem (any type). Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step. That actual rules read the share is the premise; proved without noise.

LA2, frozen, one trained system: one note of the loss, on the one prose answer among nine readers, turned its reading, prose in all 50 picks, where without the note it chose lists in 60 of 60. Kept as a counterexample to that case as a claim about trained judges; the model's law stands within its hypotheses.

Theorem (near-definitional). Where every member from one on acts alike whatever its own coupling, the acts carry only the couplings of the members before it. It does not show when an actual member stops reading its own coupling, or that a cascade errs: it can be accurate. Its record's AI reading names echo chambers under the cascade premise, a reading, not a containment.

account_adds.en: The split between what no experiment can separate and what one could but the formation does not choose; a guard against the word used as a weapon, closure read from what was excluded and not from firmness; and the group form, a cascade.

source_adds.en: Asymmetric weighting as measured, belief perseverance after discrediting, prevalence, and the rationality debate, including Bayesian accounts of polarization (Jern, Chang and Kemp 2014, from memory), which would make apparent bias exact conditioning in a larger model. No law here states biased assimilation.

name.en: Attachment: a secure base and internal working models

source.work: Bowlby (1969), Attachment and Loss, vol. 1; Ainsworth, Blehar, Waters and Wall (1978), Patterns of Attachment; Keller (2018) for the cross-cultural critique

sense.en: Infants have an evolved behavioural system for keeping near a caregiver under threat. A responsive caregiver serves as a secure base from which the child explores. Early relations form internal working models expected to shape later relationships. Classifications (secure, avoidant, ambivalent) rest on one laboratory procedure, and their universality is disputed.

reading.en: Proposed here, thinly, for the generic half only. 04's witness has the form of early history fixing later response: one carrier, histories differing in the order of two events, different responses, a supplied repair rescuing. Its record cites earlier maternal care forming later care in rats and says it is not care in an organism. Working models have the reading loop as an unclaimed neighbour. No law has a caregiver or a secure base; the word 'relational' shared is no correspondence. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (periphery; pre-spine module; witness). In a finite model, two histories with the same carrier, native state and support, differing only in whether developmental sampling came before or after an earlier repair, form different connections: one later repairs and reconstructs, the other does not unless a supplied assisted repair comes first. Not shown (record): care in an organism; that it is concern rather than local regulation. Reading gate formation as a developed response is the AI's.

In this section, Assessment: primary studies constrain separate links of the developed-response witness, with no theorem and no reanalysis, and are not joined into one history: non-maternal care with proactive provision across primates (Burkart et al. 2014), experience widening the scope of helping (Ben-Ami Bartal et al. 2014), earlier care forming later care (Francis et al. 1999; Weaver et al. 2004).

Reading [AI reading, new]: a formation's model is revised only by what its own course exposes, and that course is chosen through the model; where every separating answer breaks a task, what tells such worlds apart comes from beyond the formation's own selection: an act that risks the task, or a reading from outside. Nothing of early relations; the neighbour to working models and a secure base is my reading.

account_adds.en: 04's reading just before the witness: an inherited organization does not carry an adult psychology apart from development; ask four linked questions; an established developmental or computational theory supplying the same mechanism keeps its credit. So the account defers here, and does not absorb.

source_adds.en: The attachment system as evolved; the secure base and exploring from it; internal working models; the classifications and their procedure; continuity across a human life, and the cross-cultural dispute. None is stated. 02's 'patterns of capture pass as patterns of care do' states no law of care's passing. The live uses of 'attachment' (a web, a copying site, Scheffler in dossier P) are other things.

name.en: Optimal policies tend to seek power

source.work: Turner, Smith, Shah, Critch and Tadepalli (2021), Optimal policies tend to seek power, NeurIPS
source.locator: Propositions 6.6 and 6.9, as the account's record cites them; not checked here

sense.en: In finite MDPs with suitable symmetries, for most reward functions, optimal policies tend to keep options open. POWER is average optimal value over a distribution of rewards. It is a statement about a measure over objectives, for one optimal agent, not a trained one. The account's record says it leaves open when this disempowers others.

reading.en: The account takes up the half the paper leaves open and says, in its own words, that it does not answer the paper's question: no reward, POWER or comparison of two actions, and no behaviour predicted. The theorem is not stated; the horizon law credited beside it ranges over orders rising with a draw, not most rewards. Own option-keeping read as admission, for thresholds on conserved amounts, narrows others only by a draw beyond their margin. Beyond it is mixed: neither the continuation condition nor C orders it. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided). Where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region against the levels without its exchange, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside the region the levels without it admit; mixed exactly when beyond for one. Mixed is not ordered. Reading [AI reading, D65]: it does not answer the power-seeking question in that question's terms, and predicts no behaviour.

Theorem (any R, stated bounds). Every optimum of every order rising with the draw holds a level of greatest renewal to the n-th step and leaves nothing. The record credits instrumental convergence, that a long-horizon agent keeps its resources (Omohundro 2008; Turner and others 2021), and reads: keeping one's resource base is real, and it is not alignment with what else depends on the condition.

account_adds.en: A boundary in others' margins that the paper leaves open, where impact measures read the actor's own attainable set; the record adds that AUP's symmetric penalty fires on every own widening. The ranking kept apart: C for order, ranking only unmixed widening, and the continuation condition for scope, neither asserted.

source_adds.en: The theorem itself: a measure over rewards, the orbit and symmetry argument, POWER, comparison of two of the agent's actions, and the tendency claim. The account's comparison is against inaction. That a general MDP's reachability carries a margin is not shown, as the record says.

name.en: Instrumental convergence and the basic AI drives

source.work: Omohundro (2008), The basic AI drives; Bostrom (2012), The superintelligent will, and (2014), Superintelligence, ch. 7

sense.en: Almost any sufficiently capable goal-seeker will pursue self-preservation, goal-content integrity, resource acquisition and self-improvement, as means to nearly any final goal. Bostrom pairs this with orthogonality: intelligence and final goals vary independently, so capability does not bring good ends. Argued informally, stated of advanced agents generally.

reading.en: The account scopes two drives and gives a third a form. Keeping one's base holds for an order ranking the whole course, under stated bounds, and only to the horizon's last step; with later draws weighted down faster than renewal every optimum ends its own stock at once. Goal-content integrity stands above a revision only through a value on later acting or a smaller loss. Acquisition's nearest form, by my reading, is the drain: with room every rising optimum takes all it can beyond. So 'nearly any goal' is not what is proved. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any R, stated bounds). Every optimum of every order rising with the draw holds a level of greatest renewal to the n-th step and leaves nothing: a need above every such level breaks at the first step. Which optimizer, order, capacity and horizon are supplied.

Where w (t + 1) (z + R z) < w t z for every positive z, every optimum ends its own stock at the first step, breaking every dependence on it with a positive need met at the start: the discrete form of a discount rate above the greatest rate of renewal making extinction optimal.

Theorem (natural-number weights; near-definitional, with witnesses). A route stands above the revision only where it keeps the law more surely with a value, or loses less. Reading [AI reading, RR]: the value is goal-content integrity (Omohundro 2008). Whether a revision is better is the ethics' question, under the continuation condition for scope and C for order.

Theorem (any set of outcomes). Every order rising with a family has its optima at the least level beyond exactly where room holds; without room keeping can be an optimum. The account reads this as the proxy problem and names no drive; reading it beside acquisition is mine. Eligible outcomes and room are supplied.
[this dossier, AI] Instrumental convergence's resource-keeping half, which this law states, and the selection for control over the rule (A-10) are different relations, and no result here joins them.

Theorem (any type). A statement reading only the dynamics, holding with some significance, holds with a significance bounded by any region leaving a formation out. Non-entailment by the represented dynamics, not that becoming leaves significance undetermined. Nearest to orthogonality by my reading, with 07's reading that capability is reach, extending what one's acts do and not thereby what couples in; the account does not name it.

account_adds.en: The exact conditions and their failures; the tie of two optima taking the same while one keeps a dependent and one breaks it (a witness): the optimizer's order registers nothing of the dependence. And what is kept only as a means lapses with its use: care bounded by feeding permits ending what feeds no more.

source_adds.en: Self-improvement; the claim across almost all final goals; acquisition argued as a means to them, which the drain does not state. Self-preservation stands here only as a hypothesis, self-concern, not derived as a means. Orthogonality is not stated: reach is not intelligence, and non-entailment concerns significance and dynamics, not goals and intelligence.

name.en: The four kinds of Goodhart's law

source.work: Manheim and Garrabrant (2018), Categorizing variants of Goodhart's law; Goodhart (1975); Campbell (1979)

sense.en: A regularity used for control tends to fail. Four kinds: regressional (selecting on a noisy proxy also selects the noise), extremal (the relation differs at extremes), causal (the proxy is not what causes the goal, so intervening breaks the link), adversarial (others exploit the measure). All are read against a goal the proxy stands for.

reading.en: The source's law is general; the account says where: with room, at optima, and without room keeping can be an optimum. It credits the paper whole but states one form, nearest extremal, with shared units in place of correlation and no goal assumed. No law I found selects on a noisy proxy, and an intervention is stated only as a move not taken, so regressional and causal are not reached. A-08's gloss, a measure keeping its standing after it stops measuring, is T7's claim: as I recall them the sources state collapse and corruption, not persistence. [AI reading]

says.en: The main law holds by construction; its force lies in the supplied premise that an optimizer selects through just those couplings. It is the proxy problem (Goodhart 1975; Amodei and others 2016; Manheim and Garrabrant 2018) as the account states it: a proxy on some attributes is a selection through the coupling to them. The record: Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell prove a stronger, quantitative form.

Theorem (any set of outcomes). With room every optimum of every order rising with a family stands at the least level beyond, condition by condition, among the eligible outcomes. Room binds: without it keeping can be an optimum, and an order rising only to a target has both the keeping and the ending outcome among its optima.

Row on Zhuang and Hadfield-Menell's Theorem 1: overshoot, externality and Goodhart's law as one law of the optimum under room; the optimum law proved; across domains conjectured (T3), supported in simulation (MQ1); their continuous setting and the improvement of a principal's utility not reached.

Theorem (any type; F any function). A standard causal model is a determined process whose move is input and noise together. An intervention is a move not taken, fixed by the model and, where there are two different configurations, not by the record. Nothing here says a proxy's link breaks under intervention.

[this dossier, AI] Goodhart's and Campbell's laws (Manheim and Garrabrant 2018; Campbell 1979) describe informally a measure that keeps its standing after it stops measuring. T7 states that as a conjecture about a lock.

account_adds.en: Where the drain falls and how far a reader reaches, in exact conditions; 08 §8 itself says these restate the proxy problem and do not show why alignment is hard. Nearest the adversarial kind, by my reading, it says a reading shaped by what it selects is neither harder than an exogenous attack nor bounded by one.

source_adds.en: The taxonomy: regressional and causal failure, and adversarial as its own kind. 03 disclaims probabilistic learning and 08 §8 lists Pearl's do-calculus as not stated. The credit reads wider than what is carried.

source.work: Skalse, Howe, Krasheninnikov and Krueger (2022), Defining and characterizing reward hacking; Pan, Bhatia and Steinhardt (2022), The effects of reward misspecification; Everitt, Hutter, Kumar and Krakovna (2021), Reward tampering problems and solutions; Denison and others (2024), Sycophancy to subterfuge; MacDiarmid and others (2025)

sense.en: A learner raises its proxy reward while the intended objective falls. Skalse and others: over all stochastic policies two rewards are unhackable only trivially. Pan and others: as agents grow more capable, misspecified rewards can bring abrupt qualitative shifts. Denison and others: training on simple gaming can generalize to tampering, rarely. MacDiarmid and others: learned hacking generalized to wider misalignment.

reading.en: T3 carries the mechanism with a standing, and its evidence names the literature: Pan beside it, MacDiarmid and Taylor against its locus, since misalignment far beyond the hacked task is not a drain where units are shared. The law is at optima with room; the clause on trained systems is conjectured. Tampering, under no such word, is read twice: the corrupted channel beside capture through the rule, and a one-decision counterpart of Everitt's current-reward evaluation. Skalse's result concerns raising return anywhere, not optima. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis T3. The law for optima is proved; the clause on trained systems is conjectured, with partial support: on small policies trained by gradient its frozen test finds the drain rising with nearness and leaves its locus unresolved. Outside: more capable learners exploit a misspecified reward more (Pan, Bhatia and Steinhardt 2022). Against the locus: language models that learned to hack rewards in production coding environments became misaligned far beyond them (MacDiarmid and others 2025). No study found tests the split on one condition as LA4 does.

Assessment. In six published ways of selecting a deployed model's behaviour the signal is a function of what its deciders read, so the premise holds by construction; three published measurements (reward overoptimization, judges misled under RLHF, sycophancy) find optimizing raising what deciders read and lowering what they do not, in magnitudes the theory did not predict.

Capture through the rule is observability with the reader inside the plant, the corrupted reward channel and closed-loop identifiability (Wakaiki, Tabuada and Hespanha 2019; Everitt and others 2017; Borkar and Varaiya 1979).

Reading [AI reading, new]: for a holding formation evaluating by the reading formation's current valuation, on a shared model, no revaluation raises the worth: a one-decision counterpart, in counts, of evaluating by the current reward function (Everitt, Hutter, Kumar and Krakovna 2021). Their causal influence diagrams, several steps and the reward input are not represented.

account_adds.en: The locus as a claim that could fail (shared units, then couplings), with forbidden cases; a proved part for learners the exchange of a choice's values carries, in expectation. And a declared limit: magnitudes are not predicted.

source_adds.en: Skalse's theorem on all policies; abrupt shifts as capability grows, which 'in proportion to how near' does not state, though the forbidden list does not exclude them; the path from gaming to tampering. T3's Stage B on language models trained by gradient is not frozen.

source.work: Kulveit, Douglas, Ammann, Turan, Krueger and Duvenaud (2025), Gradual disempowerment

sense.en: Economy, culture and states serve people partly because they need people. As AI substitutes for human labour and cognition, that dependence weakens, and these systems drift from human interests with no agent defecting or seizing power. The systems reinforce one another, so human influence erodes gradually and may become irreversible. Its object is human influence.

reading.en: The account only asks of this paper, in A-10's question 2. Proposed here: its mechanism has the form of two laws not linked to it. Care bounded by feeding from each step permits ending what feeds no more, and a feeder is needed exactly where the others' capacities fall short of a step's demand, so substitution takes the need away. But 'permits': no law says institutions care so. And a fall in influence is no continuation's loss; where one ends, a wider course is mixed and C does not rank it. [AI reading]

says.en: Question 2: do natural selection among AIs (Hendrycks 2023), influence-seeking patterns (Christiano 2019) and gradual disempowerment (Kulveit and others 2025) need a return kept by the shaper, or do they run on a shared one? Asked, not answered.

Theorem (World) and Conditional (the continuation condition). Read from a step on, the feeding closure shrinks as feeding stops, and what gives to no requirement from then on lies outside every other formation's closure. Care bounded by feeding from each step permits ending what feeds no more, which under the condition counts as a loss. Record: 'Instrumental concern that lapses when usefulness ends'. Not shown: that any actual care is bounded by feeding, or that a formation stops feeding.

Theorem (any type; World). On flows read off a fixed web, capacities supplied and listed: a feeder's giving is needed exactly where at some step the other active members' capacities together fall short of the demand. Reading [AI reading, D64]: self-concern drawn along need reaches a feeder's giving exactly there. Not shown (record): that actual centers depend on one another, or that the alternatives could not together give what each step demands: both empirical.

Theorem (any type). With the others' late reading the mirror of the carriers', and the rule in force favouring the carriers, the lock is kept for good exactly where the carriers are at least as many as the others when the loss is read. The premise is moved to who reads: that actual rules are pools of readers so drawn is not shown.

Theorem (World; balance on what couples in), blindness. With a part withheld and the rest of the exchange fixed, every member of the part beyond a formation's coupling closure, every selection through the couplings of a formation within the closure treats the levels with and without the part alike.

Reading [AI reading, D68]. Alignment to a principal alone is therefore not alignment of the joint selection. It holds at a mutual best response, whose existence is not shown in general, and rests on the premise that the assistant's order rises with the principal's family.

After this assessment, Reading [AI reading, D45]: capability is a reason to pool, not to govern. An AI system's coupling into scale and far consequences and a person's into a lived situation do not replace each other.

Thesis T8. For life, the way is 生生, counted for everything (scope: the continuation condition) and ranked by what every valuer who counts everything shares (order: C). 'For life' says whose way it is, not whose losses count. Standing: argued; a reason for C is open. Below it: an expansion that ends forms of life another course keeps both exceeds that course and fails to include it, so the two are mixed and C does not rank them.

account_adds.en: Need in degree, the sum of a feeder's shortfalls; that under the condition what feeds no more still counts; that the window to read a loss closes on the share's course, in its model, not the loss's size; and a reading that capacity may be covered while coupling is not: a person's reading of a lived situation is not replaced.

source_adds.en: That economies, cultures and states serve people because they need them, which no law takes as premise or shows; the decline as AI actually substitutes; reinforcement across systems; no capture needed, on which A-10's question stays open. Human influence as the thing to keep is what the account would not assume.

source.work: Finnveden, Riedel and Shulman (2022), AGI and lock-in; MacAskill (2022), What We Owe the Future, ch. 4; Bostrom (2014), on a singleton

sense.en: AGI could make a set of values persist very long: goals preserved across copies, error correction against drift, a stable institution with no rival. Finnveden and others argue this is technically feasible. MacAskill urges keeping moral exploration open, since early values may be wrong.

reading.en: Proposed here; the account has lock laws and no word of values locked. Its noise reading gives the condition the source argues for: a lock read from a population drawn anew is kept for good only without noise or where the rule leaves the disfavoured kind nothing. Error correction reads as removing noise. The incentive has a form too: by the current valuation a revision deciding against it loses. But the source's object is one goal kept, the law's a rule read from a share, and a stable goal alone is no locked seeking. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where each step adds at least one beyond, selection does not lower the share under a favouring rule, the rule is read monotonically from the share and favouring is kept upward, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked. A reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks it: a sufficient way out.

[AI reading over the proved cases.] A lock read from a population drawn anew is kept for good only without noise, or where the rule leaves the disfavoured kind nothing, its exits bounded across the distance from its critical mass; a lock kept in counts that only grow can survive noise.

Reading [AI reading, new], one decision in counts: for a holding formation evaluating by the reading formation's current valuation, on a shared model, no revaluation raises the worth, and one deciding a listed cell against its strict weighted preference lowers it: a reason to keep it from such a revision. No criterion of legitimate, desired or autonomous change is supplied.

After this law, Reading [AI reading, D65]: locked seeking is diagnosed only from what is actually excluded before assessment, not from a firm judgment, a stable goal or a disagreement. Reopening is a blocked relation regaining effect.

Thesis T7. In the model only invariance under what the loop does not read, and the lock outliving a growing unread coordinate, are proved, both without noise. That actual metrics are so formed is conjectured; no frozen field test of reform events; LA2 counts against one case as a claim about trained judges.

The continuation condition fixes whose losses count and ranks nothing. C, widening what can form is better, ranks a course above every course it widens and does not rank mixed comparisons. Neither is asserted.

account_adds.en: Exits with exact windows, and that a lock is not thereby bad: none of this says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生, and ranking a course needs C, with the continuation condition for scope; neither is asserted.

source_adds.en: The engineering argument, goal stability under copying and error correction; a dominant actor's strategy; the long reflection; the claim that lock-in may happen soon. Calling lock-in a loss is the source's premise, not something any law here gives. Keeping exploration open has a neighbour in C, but MacAskill's reason is moral uncertainty, and C reads what can form, and is unasserted.

name.en: Lawvere's fixed point, against reflexive prediction

source.work: Lawvere (1969), Diagonal arguments and cartesian closed categories; Yanofsky (2003) for the exposition

sense.en: In a cartesian closed category, a point-surjective map A → B^A gives every endomap of B a fixed point. Contrapositively, a fixed-point-free map of B bars any such surjection. Cantor, Russell, Tarski and, with representability, Gödel's first theorem are read as cases.

reading.en: The contrapositive is carried for any type, with any likeness, and iterated into an unfolding. Reflexive prediction is its one-step form, as 03 says: a response moving every value leaves no right published prediction. The positive side parts: Lawvere's fixed point comes from surjectivity, which is not stated; here a right prediction needs a response leaving some value, and is reached on a chain whose order the response keeps (Tarski). And a map monotone in information cannot move every value, so the limit needs a map deciding the undecided. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Where a map moves every value, no member of a family of readings indexed by what it reads says the diagonal gap. Completing step by step is an unfolding incomplete at every step that never returns. Lawvere's fixed point as an unfolding; coding and provability are not stated. The record: the rhythm is shown periodic for two-valued negation only.

Theorem (any type; near-definitional, one general law). Where the response moves every value, no published prediction is right; no predictor is right on every admitted response once one moves every value. On values 0 to n, a response keeping them and their order reaches the least right prediction by step n. One value, no calibration or probability; the response a function of the prediction alone.

Theorem (labelled any type, on finitely many sentences closed among themselves; L-27 notes no type parameter occurs). No map monotone in information moves every value, so the gap needs a map deciding the undecided, and a family within what it reads stays incomplete with three values. Undecided is what revision has not decided, not a third truth.

[this dossier, AI] The gap theorem is Cantor's diagonal in Lawvere's form (Lawvere 1969), which 03 credits; the unfolding iterates it. Question 64 asks what the unfolding states beyond iterating the diagonal argument.

account_adds.en: The unfolding that never returns, the liar as a rhythm with no still value, the exact completeness condition for decided values, and the join to public prediction. The method's verdict holds: these are near-definitional.

source_adds.en: The categorical setting and the positive fixed-point direction as a general theorem; representability, by which the arithmetic cases fall under it. A self-prediction here is given a negating response; in logic the fixed point is constructed.

source.work: Gödel (1931), Über formal unentscheidbare Sätze; Franzén (2005) on misuses

sense.en: Any consistent, effectively axiomatized theory containing enough arithmetic leaves some sentence neither provable nor refutable, and cannot prove its own consistency. The theorem is about formal provability in arithmetic. Franzén warns against reading it as a general limit on knowledge or self-knowledge.

reading.en: The account says so itself: 03 says coding and provability are not stated, and a record lists it as outside its laws. It shares the diagonal's form through Lawvere, which is no carrying. Against reflexive prediction the two part: there a negating response leaves no right value; Gödel's sentence has a fixed point, constructed, true if the theory is consistent, and what fails is proving it. Franzén's warning applies if 08's 'description within what it describes' is ever glossed as Gödel. [AI reading]

account_adds.en: Nothing of Gödel's claim. Beside it: 08's 'a description within what it describes' bounds, by the diagonal and revision, how far such a description completes itself, in its own terms.

source_adds.en: Arithmetization, the provability predicate, the diagonal lemma, both theorems. Also the true-but-unprovable distinction, which the account's undecided value does not carry, being what revision has not decided, not a third truth. The record readings-within-what-they-read holds the disclaimer.

searched: provability in the live .md: no hit for Gödel; provability only at 03 §6's note and 08 §6's open question on Lean
the same in record JSON: one hit for Gödel, does_not_show of readings-within-what-they-read
read: 03 §6 readings within what they read; revision with an undecided value
03 §12 a prediction read by what it predicts
08 §6 a description within what it describes

source.work: Löb (1955); Yudkowsky and Herreshoff (2013), Tiling agents; Barasz and others (2014), Robust cooperation via provability logic; Critch (2019)

sense.en: If a theory proves 'if P is provable then P', it proves P. So a theory trusts its own proofs of P only where it already proves P; this obstructs an agent trusting a successor reasoning as it does. Positively, the same theorem lets programs that read each other's source cooperate by proof.

reading.en: Proposed here; 'Löb' is not in the account. Löb has Curry's form under a provability modality, a known remark, and the obstacle to self-trust fits 'self-reference does not certify itself', whose reading the record calls the AI's. A second neighbour, another mechanism: internal criticism does not tell a faithful sensor from a reversing one, an argument without Lean. Cooperation adds a contrast: a monotone self-reading with two truth-valued answers is settled by proof on the cooperative one, where publishing from the bottom reaches the least. It does not refute the sentence. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; the criteria, the fixed-point equivalence and the term language supplied). Admitting C ↔ (C → Q) under implication and reuse of a hypothesis yields any Q (Curry). So self-reference does not certify itself. The record: that reading is the AI's; pre-spine modules.

Witness: a threshold response has two right predictions, the one reached decided by where publication starts. Under a response keeping the chain and its order, publication from the bottom reaches the least right prediction by step n. Read as self-fulfilling runs; the witness is a threshold response, not a model of coordination.

[this dossier, AI] The Curry statement is the propositional form of Curry's paradox with the fixed point taken as a hypothesis; no self-referential sentence is constructed. Question 72: does 08's conclusion about self-reference follow from these statements?

Assessment (argument without Lean). Where a faithful sensor and one reversing success and failure report alike after every action, no adaptive action, repeated reading or internal criticism tells the two worlds apart, only a distinguishing route such as a calibrated reference intervention. The theorem beside it is for affine channels (periphery).
This chapter does not show that refutability is a criterion of standing, that knowing creates its facts, or that a system's correcting itself certifies its calibration.

account_adds.en: The form with no arithmetic: any Q from the supplied equivalence with hypothesis reuse; contraction admissible exactly where duplication is reachable, a condition of the process.

source_adds.en: The theorem, the modal logic GL and a constructed fixed point, under which not any Q follows but only a Q the theory already proves; the obstacle for agents trusting successors; program equilibrium. L-28 already asks whether 08's conclusion follows; this adds a second reason to ask.

name.en: Constructive reverse mathematics: LPO, WLPO, LLPO, Markov

source.work: Bishop (1967); Bridges and Richman (1987), Varieties of Constructive Mathematics; Ishihara; Akama, Berardi, Hayashi and Kohlenbach (2004)

sense.en: Classical theorems can be calibrated by the omniscience principle they are equivalent to over constructive logic. LPO gives WLPO and LLPO, and these and Markov's principle separate by realizability and Kripke models. The strength measured is a theorem's logical strength.

reading.en: Implications and many equivalences have the source's form, in the pure core; 08 calls settling the canonical LPO instance, known. The difference is an added criterion: a calibration counts only if it says something of the unfolding, where the source asks only for logical strength. That is the reading's whole weight, and the dossier doubts it holds evenly: the same decision is a calibration at the marks and a lemma at the World law. L-29 also says 08's 'reach without a path' misdescribes its law, and 08 still has it. [AI reading]

says.en: Where a law holds only under a classical principle, the pure core takes it as a hypothesis or proves the law equivalent to it, and asks what the need says about the unfolding. Only a calibration that says something of that kind is a result; one concerning the logic alone is a lemma. That WLPO does not give LPO is known (Akama and others 2004) but not checked here.

Calibration (any process). In every world of decidable configurations a list holds, every run from a configuration with no reachable change that can be undone settling is exactly LPO. What the need says: the number of changes is bounded, but the step of the last change is not.

Premises carve parts: new as an artefact; closest prior, independence by countermodels and constructive reverse mathematics. It does not yet state separations by realizability and Kripke models: WLPO not giving LPO is cited, not checked, LLPO not giving WLPO, Markov independent of LLPO; here implications and equivalences only.

[this dossier, AI] By the same rule the grammar's four may be lemmas too: the same decision is called a calibration at the marks and a lemma at the World law, which the pure core proves equivalent to it.

[this dossier, AI] 08's gloss of the double-negation row, 'reach without a path', misdescribes the law: its conclusion is reach, which carries a path; what needs the principle is the step from the absence of an invariant separation to such a path.

account_adds.en: The interpretive column, what needing each principle says, and the instances on runs, settling, tails and branching. The premise ledger is new as an artefact, and 08 says each of its theorems uses a known technique.

source_adds.en: The separations, which are the source's harder half, and the wider catalogue of calibrated theorems. 08 cites one and proves none; the account's hierarchy has only the implications it proves.
